scope: Public read-only verification of four canonical Robinhood stock tokens and direct USDG Uniswap v3 routes. No wallets, signing, funding or broadcast.

verificationSummary.runtimeValuation: Actual stock ERC20 units quoted through Uniswap QuoterV2 into USDG; USDG is the unit reference. No share-price feed or multiplier is applied to DEX quotes.
limitations: No signer, approval, funded sender simulation, broadcast or receipt was tested.
Public RPC observations do not establish local consensus or sequencer-uptime verification.
AMM quote availability does not prove legal eligibility to hold or trade issuer-backed stock tokens.
oraclePaused is a corporate-action advisory flag, not a market-open flag.
DEX prices can diverge from underlying share values outside or during market hours.
